name: Auto Replant Tree
description: Automatically replants saplings when you break a log block. Works on the server — no client mod needed. Features: All vanilla tree types (Oak, Spruce, Birch, Jungle, Acacia, Dark Oak, Mangrove, Cherry), Nether trees (Crimson & Warped fungi on nylium), 2x2 replanting for Dark Oak & Jungle, sneak to cancel, no-sapling mode (requireSapling: false), full inventory search including offhand, per-tree config via config/autoreplant.json.
